test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five people are sitting on a bench facing north. S is to the immediate left of R and to the immediate right of B. M is to the right of R. T is between R and M. Who is sitting to the immediate right of T?
solution:
Given: Five people are sitting on a bench facing north.

1) S is to the immediate left of R and to the immediate right of B.

2) M is to the right of R.

3) T is between R and M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2674f50d09126d348d98f534ef0db28197cb039fe3c881aee51893cccbf2193.png] 

Here, 'M' is sitting to the immediate right of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
